# `aitbc network subscribe`

Register this node as a follower for block subscription.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc network subscribe [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-id` | text | — | no | Unique identifier for this follower node (default: from NODE_ID in /etc/aitbc/node.env) |
| `--transport` | choice | `websocket` | no | Transport method for block delivery |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to subscribe to (default: from SUPPORTED_CHAINS in /etc/aitbc/node.env) |
| `--duration` | integer | `300` | no | Lease duration in seconds (default: 300) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc network subscribe
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc network subscribe --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
